rgb.label: RGB
rgb.basis: 74% of surface objects, ranked by analyst visual tier then object size.

thermal.label: Thermal
thermal.basis: 72% of surface metal at least 10 cm across, and 18% of shallow metal, largest first. Needs exposed area to hold a thermal contrast, so no minimum-metal detections.

emi.label: EMI
emi.basis: EM61-Lite channel 1, thresholded at a 10% background-area false-alarm rate.

mag.label: Magnetic
mag.basis: MagDrone R1 processed anomaly grid, thresholded at a 10% background-area false-alarm rate.

combined.rule: Detect if any sensor fires; count a false alarm only where two or more sensors fire within 0.5 m.

measured.note: Measured directly from the surveys over the whole field. Independent of the representative optical figures.
measured.false_alarm_basis: Fraction of surveyed background area a sensor would flag.

sensitivity.basis: Measured AUC over a sweep of sampling radius (0.25-0.45 m) and background separation (1.0-1.5 m). EMI holds across every configuration; magnetic stays weak; optical stays at or below chance. The reported figures use 0.35 m and 1.25 m.

measured.background_note: 150 emplacements at about 1 m spacing leave little clean ground: the background used for thresholds is roughly 10 m2 of a 383 m2 field.

visual_review.basis: Analyst read of native-resolution 3.12 mm/px crops at the 30 surface positions, with ground-truth locations shown.
